description: A contributor by email (exact) or name (substring): canonical name, page hash, totals and per-release counts by role (authored, reviewed, committed, reported, ...), the 5 latest credited commits (commit_sha = git SHA, roles = their roles in it) and animals they own. People who hid their page are left out of name lookups. Recent activity: whats_new. Cite https://pg.ddx.io/community/<hash>.
name: get_contributor
